entries.note: Event type 100 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Parcel information submitted,we haven't received the parcel yet".
Event type 200 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your parcel has been scheduled for pickup". The same title as status 900; 200 is the pickup booking.
Event type 300 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your parcel is out for pickup today".
Event type 400 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Pickup attempt wasn't successful". The courier has not collected the parcel yet.
Event type 500 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Parcel Picked up successfully".
Event type 600 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your parcel has arrived at our National hub".
Event type 700 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your Parcel is pending transfer from the national hub.".
Event type 800 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Parcel has left the National hub".
Event type 900 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your parcel has been scheduled for delivery". The same title as status 200; 900 is the delivery booking.
Event type 1000 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your parcel is out for delivery today".
Event type 1100 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Delivery attempt wasn’t successful".
Event type 1200 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your parcel has been scheduled for return".
Event type 1300 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your parcel is in transit back to the sender.".
Event type 1400 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Return attempt wasn't successful".
Event type 1500 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your parcel has been successfully returned as requested.".
Event type 1570 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Your parcel has been destroyed".
Event type 1600 in XLCourier's tracking status list, described as "Delivered-thank you for choosing XLC!".
